phases.title: Meeting #1
items: Tasks assigned for the coming week
Prior week's slides due 6 p.m. via Slack to Research Leads

phases.title: Independent research
items: Form a hypothesis and answer the assigned question

phases.title: Meeting #2
items: Discuss findings, brainstorm slide structure, get analysis help
RLs submit final versions of the prior week's slides

phases.title: Slide creation
items: Build slides, resolve issues with RLs, send draft updates, complete earlier edits

engagement.subline: A 60+ page read-deck, a roughly 11-week semester, and a closing presentation to the client.

steps.title: Scoping
steps.body: The client chooses the vertical, and together we set the questions the work must answer.

steps.title: Research
steps.body: Analysts build the secondary base: market structure, value chain, technology, regulation and key players.

steps.title: Expert calls
steps.body: Conversations with industry experts test our assumptions and fill gaps published sources leave open.

steps.title: Synthesis
steps.body: Findings are distilled into a 60+ page read-deck with a clear point of view.

steps.title: Final presentation
steps.body: The team presents its conclusions and recommendations to the client at the end of the engagement.
